d: Sacred forest of the Druids; in the middle of the oak of Irminsul, at the foot of which I saw the druid stone that serves as an altar. Necks scattered with wild trees. It is night; far fires leak from the woods.
Druids from the bottom, Priestesses, Warriors, Bardi, Eubagi, Sacrificers, and among all Orovese.
He has loosed his hair, his forehead surrounded by a wreath of vervain, and armed his hand with a golden sickle. He sits on the druid stone, and turns his eyes around as inspired. Everyone is silent.
Home of Norma. Norma, Clotilde: carry two little Children by the hand.
Inside the house of Norma. On one side a Roman bed covered with bear skin. The sons of Norma are asleep.
Lonely place near the Druids wood surrounded by ravines and caves. At the end a lake crossed by a stone bridge. Gallic warriors.
Temple of Irminsul, ara on one side, norma, indi Clotilde.
Orovese, the Druids, the Bardi and the Ministre flow from various parts. Gradually the temple is filled with Armati. Norma is placed on the altar.
Oroveso, the Druids, the Bardi and the Warriors return.
